findings.text: test_the_real_crew_home_is_untouched asserts a glob equal to itself, so the assertion cannot fail whatever the sweep did; the real guard rests only on the real_store_is_not_a_fixture_target helper call above it.
STAGING_ROOT_KEY is added to a file outside the node's fenced write paths; the plan prose names the flight schema but FENCE - SCOPE did not grant it, so the change needs coordinator ratification.

the sweep calls report_retention._newest_write, a private function, into a module that already owns an equivalent _newest_mtime helper, duplicating the walk capability rather than extending its owner.
the declared figures path received nothing and the evidence fragment carries no figure, though the node's write scope reserved a directory for one.
